rows.target: Quantile of the largest loss in portfolio value before or at the horizon
rows.data: Modeled lognormal portfolio-value paths; illustrative parameter settings
rows.evaluation: MaxVaR/VaR ratios across tail probabilities and parameters; discrete-monitoring illustration
rows.evidence_scope: Author-hosted six-page original, §§2–3 and Tables 1–2; publisher issue record; author publication lists
rows.qualification: Published pagination 14–19 is supported by coauthor publication lists; the consulted PDF has local pagination 1–6. The study is an analytic/illustrative comparison, not a realized forecasting-score backtest.

rows.target: Extreme quantiles of the largest end-of-day net debit across ACSS participants
rows.data: ACSS daily participant settlement balances, January 2002–March 2017
rows.method: GEV block maxima and GPD threshold exceedances; maximum likelihood
rows.evaluation: Empirical/fitted quantile diagnostics and sensitivity; monthly-updated collateral-pool shortfalls, 2007–2017
rows.evidence_scope: Official Payments Canada Discussion Paper 7, January 2019 update; §§2,3(c),4 and4(b), printed pp.8–15
rows.qualification: The first maximum is across participants at a daily endpoint; weekly/monthly block maxima then aggregate these daily observations. Do not conflate it with a single dealer within-horizon path peak.

rows.target: Conditional quantile of the largest cumulative negative net payment balance within a fixed interval
rows.data: Confidential ABN AMRO Bank transaction data
rows.method: Transaction-duration/amount modeling, simulated paths and extreme-value methods
rows.evaluation: Violation-based unconditional-coverage and independence backtests; numerical application results confidential
rows.evidence_scope: Institution-hosted original thesis indexed body passages: §1.3 p.3; §5.2 p.59; §5.4 pp.67–72; §5.5 p.77. Direct PDF requests timed out; retrieved institution-indexed original body passages rather than a successful full PDF download.
rows.qualification: The public original specifies the backtesting methodology, while §5.5 backtesting results are confidential/redacted. No empirical success rate is inferable. One-sided cash liquidity target; not two-sided position magnitude.

rows.target: Interval for the next-hour signed net position
rows.data: One market maker, NetPositionTimeSeries FX data family
rows.method: Regression engines including KNN, with quantile/conformal/normalized-conformal intervals; moving-average benchmark
rows.evaluation: Average of lower/upper pinball losses; interval width, coverage, Winkler score and coverage/independence tests
rows.evidence_scope: Official PMLR metadata and17-page original PDF: §1 and§§3.2–4.2, especially physical pp.6–11
rows.qualification: Same data family is verified; identity of the exact raw source bytes/preprocessing used by the two papers is unverified. Published proceedings pagination is285–301; PDF local pagination is1–17.

rows.target: 0.95 quantile of the two-sided absolute sampled position peak over the holding horizon
rows.data: Hourly FX dealer net-position series and weekly NY Fed primary-dealer Treasury-bill aggregate
rows.method: Historical rules versus ridge quantile regression and nearest-neighbour quantiles, with matched completed-label histories and refit schedules
rows.evaluation: Pinball loss; paired DM comparisons; mean underprediction/overprediction; breaches and sparse-grid coverage diagnostics
rows.evidence_scope: Target/data/methods verified in local manuscript baseline; DM and sparse-grid coverage diagnostics belong to the current revision and require integration with the inference outputs.
rows.qualification: The row describes the intended revised-paper evaluation suite, not independent verification that every new inference output has been integrated. Position magnitudes are source-reported observations, not measured inventory costs, cash needs or observed policy benefits.
